claims.scope: Approximate basin-wide eastward pathway from north of Papua New Guinea to the South American coast described in Grenier et al. (2011). The source's 14,000 km is a broad path estimate, not a traced instantaneous core or the length of the Atlantic or Indian Equatorial Undercurrent. A 0°N, 140°W mooring locates the current independently.

A later wave–current dynamics paper describes the Pacific EUC as traversing the equatorial Pacific over about 13,000 km. It does not define the same exact core or gates as Grenier et al.; retained as a source-specific whole-basin approximation rather than an independent rank.
claims.source_locator: Introduction, opening Equatorial Undercurrent description, entire Pacific equatorial length about 13,000 km
